issues.title: Missing Environment Variables

issues.context: Test environment does not have production credentials configured
issues.impact: Blocks Phase 2-11 testing (WebApp, Database, RSS, Channels, Groups, Scheduling, Automation, Analytics, Settings, Error Handling)

issues.title: Test WebApp Server Crashes on Startup
issues.description: test-webapp-server.js prints startup message but immediately exits without listening on port 3001
stepsToReproduce: Wait for 'Press Ctrl+C to stop' message
issues.expected: Server should listen on port 3001 and respond to health checks
issues.actual: Server prints startup banner then exits. Connection refused on port 3001.
issues.context: The server starts (we see the banner) but crashes before express.listen() completes
issues.impact: Blocks Phase 2 (WebApp & API Testing) - cannot test any web endpoints
issues.suggestedFix: Debug test-webapp-server.js - check for unhandled exceptions in middleware setup or initial route configuration

summary_text: Phase 1 completed with 4/5 tests passing. Environment is healthy (Node v22, npm deps installed, 338 unit tests passing). However, 2 critical blockers prevent Phase 2-11 testing: (1) Missing env variables (expected in dev), (2) WebApp test server crashes on startup. These must be resolved to proceed with full testing.
nextSteps: Configure BOT_TOKEN and SUPABASE_URL for production-like testing
Debug test-webapp-server.js startup crash - check server initialization code
Once WebApp server runs, proceed to Phase 2 API testing
